phases.name: Relief & Stabilization
phases.desc: Foundation of Safety: Establishes nervous system coherence and emotional regulation as prerequisites for deeper work.

phases.name: Activation & Alignment
phases.desc: Energy Architecture: Awakens and organizes the body's subtle energy systems, creating a stable foundation for expanded awareness.

phases.name: Integration of Forces
phases.desc: Coherent Synthesis: Harmonizes multiple energy currents and intelligence centers into a unified field of awareness.

phases.name: Cosmic Expansion & Archetypal Union
phases.desc: Universal Connection: Connects individual consciousness with cosmic patterns and archetypal forces for expanded perspective and power.

phases.name: Mastery & Completion
phases.desc: Embodied Transcendence: Integrates all awakened capacities into stable, everyday functionality while maintaining access to transcendent states.

cards.title: The Flame Of Purity
cards.phrase: Ancient wisdom flows through the threshold of now
cards.meditation: Inhale golden light of eternal mysteries; exhale as your soul remembers its connection to all sacred traditions
cards.interpretation: You stand at the doorway between worlds. Trust the ancient wisdom flowing through you as you step into your spiritual power with confidence and grace
cards.grounded_supported: This is the discomfort right before a real decision, not a sign something's wrong. The old way of operating doesn't fit anymore, and the new one isn't confirmed yet — and that's tolerable.
cards.grounded_resisted: Staying in the doorway too long — over-preparing, seeking one more sign, one more course, instead of stepping through.
cards.grounded_where: The gap between knowing you need to change something and actually doing it.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll act once you're ready, or keep finding reasons to prepare a little longer.

cards.title: Cosmic Harmony
cards.phrase: Balance emerges from the dance of opposites
cards.meditation: Inhale warm orange expansion; exhale cool blue contraction, feeling the spiral of creation spinning within your heart
cards.interpretation: Life's apparent chaos contains perfect order. Release the need to control and trust the cosmic dance that brings all things into divine balance.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop trying to force two conflicting things into agreement and let them coexist instead. The tension itself turns out to be workable, not a problem to solve.
cards.grounded_resisted: Gripping tighter on one side of a conflict, treating balance as a fight you have to win rather than a rhythm you can enter.
cards.grounded_where: A disagreement, a schedule, or a relationship where you keep trying to make one side 'win.'
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let a tension resolve itself instead of needing to control which side wins.

cards.title: The Spiral of Wisdom
cards.phrase: Consciousness expands through sacred geometry
cards.meditation: Inhale along the golden spiral inward; exhale as your awareness extends boundlessly outward through crystalline dimensions
cards.interpretation: Your consciousness is expanding into new dimensions of understanding. Each breath draws you deeper into the mystery while simultaneously expanding your awareness.
cards.grounded_supported: You're learning something faster than you can fully process it, and that's fine — understanding is arriving in layers, not all at once.
cards.grounded_resisted: Overwhelm from taking in too much too fast, mistaking the speed of new information for a sign you're behind.
cards.grounded_where: A new skill, subject, or role where you feel behind despite real progress.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can tolerate the feeling of not-yet-understanding without treating it as falling behind.

cards.title: Celestial Awakening
cards.phrase: Divine light blossoms within sacred structure
cards.meditation: Inhale the crystalline perfection of mathematical truth; exhale as your heart becomes a garden where sacred geometry spontaneously flowers into organic rapture
cards.interpretation: Spiritual realization flows through all levels of being; heaven touches earth through your embodiment.
cards.grounded_supported: An insight actually changes how you act, not just how you feel — it shows up in a conversation, a habit, a choice, not just in reflection.
cards.grounded_resisted: Staying in the idea instead of the action — good insights that never touch your calendar or your behavior.
cards.grounded_where: Something you 'understand' but haven't actually changed anything about yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether an insight actually changes your behavior, or just becomes another thing you privately agree with.

cards.title: Flame of Glory
cards.phrase: Pure consciousness rises from earthly foundations
cards.meditation: Inhale cool blue stability from below; exhale warm golden light through your crown as the lotus of awareness blooms
cards.interpretation: Your spiritual fire is awakening. Ground yourself in love and let your consciousness ascend naturally, blooming like a lotus from muddy waters into pure light.
cards.grounded_supported: Energy and motivation are real right now — the move is to root it in something concrete (a task, a commitment) before it burns off.
cards.grounded_resisted: Riding a wave of inspiration with nothing underneath it — enthusiasm with no follow-through structure.
cards.grounded_where: A new project or idea you're excited about but haven't scheduled or committed resources to yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll build structure under your motivation before it burns off on its own.

cards.title: Boundless Cycle
cards.phrase: Unity reveals itself through infinite expressions
cards.meditation: Inhale pure white light; exhale as it separates into rainbow streams of possibility, then returns to unity in your heart
cards.interpretation: You are both one and many, simple and complex. Embrace all aspects of yourself as facets of the same divine light seeking expression.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop treating your different roles or moods as contradictions — the version of you at work and the version of you at home are both real.
cards.grounded_resisted: Fragmenting — feeling like you have to be a totally different person in each context, and exhausted from the switching.
cards.grounded_where: Code-switching between roles (parent, professional, partner) that feel like they require different personalities.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can be fully present in each role you hold instead of feeling divided between them.

cards.title: The Dormant Spirit
cards.phrase: New universes birth from sacred potential
cards.meditation: Inhale the swirling galaxies of possibility; exhale into the golden center where all potential awaits activation
cards.interpretation: You are pregnant with infinite possibility. Trust the cosmic forces moving through you as new realities prepare to be born from your deepest intentions.
cards.grounded_supported: Something is forming that isn't ready to be shown yet, and that's appropriate — not everything needs to be visible or explained before it's real.
cards.grounded_resisted: Anxiety about having nothing to show, pressure to prove a thing is happening before it's actually ready.
cards.grounded_where: An early-stage plan, relationship, or project you feel pressure to justify or announce too soon.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let something develop without needing to prove it's real yet.

cards.title: The Radiant Source
cards.phrase: Pure awareness illuminates all existence
cards.meditation: Inhale golden light from the eternal source; exhale without pause as you become the sun illuminating all life.
cards.interpretation: You are the light you seek. Rest in the recognition that consciousness itself is your true nature, radiating peace and clarity to all beings.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop looking outside yourself for permission or validation — the clarity you need is already available if you get quiet enough to notice it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Chasing external confirmation — a person, a result, a title — to feel like you're allowed to trust your own read on things.
cards.grounded_where: Waiting on someone else's approval before you'll believe your own judgment.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll trust your own read on things without needing someone else to confirm it first.

cards.title: The Rainbow Feather
cards.phrase: Spectrum consciousness unfolds in divine harmony
cards.meditation: Inhale each color from root to crown; exhale as all frequencies merge into pure white light within your core
cards.interpretation: Your spiritual gifts are awakening across all dimensions. Each aspect of your being vibrates at its perfect frequency, creating a symphony of integrated consciousness.
cards.grounded_supported: Different parts of your life — work self, home self, creative self — actually start reinforcing each other instead of competing for time and attention.
cards.grounded_resisted: Feeling scattered across too many roles, like none of them are getting your full energy and all of them suffer a little.
cards.grounded_where: A season with too many active priorities and no sense of which one is actually 'you.'
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether your different roles reinforce each other, or whether you're splitting your attention too thin across all of them.

cards.title: The Solar Axis
cards.phrase: Love radiates through infinite dimensions
cards.meditation: Inhale golden energy spiraling inward; exhale as your heart becomes a star radiating love through all dimensional fields
cards.interpretation: You are a magnetic center of divine love. Your presence naturally harmonizes all energies around you, drawing truth and beauty into manifestation.
cards.grounded_supported: People and situations start organizing around your presence without you pushing — steadiness draws things toward resolution.
cards.grounded_resisted: Trying to force harmony onto a room or relationship by managing everyone's feelings instead of trusting your own steady presence.
cards.grounded_where: Being the one who always smooths things over, at your own expense.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can trust your own steady presence instead of managing everyone else's mood to feel calm.

cards.title: The Star Of Justice
cards.phrase: Perfect balance illuminates the sacred intersection
cards.meditation: Inhale light from above and below; exhale as horizontal awareness expands infinitely, creating the cross of awakened presence
cards.interpretation: You stand at the center of infinite possibility. Trust the divine order that flows through you as you become a beacon of balanced wisdom.
cards.grounded_supported: You're being asked to make a call, and the fair answer isn't the popular one — trust the read you already have.
cards.grounded_resisted: Endless deliberation dressed up as fairness — avoiding a decision because you're afraid of who it disappoints.
cards.grounded_where: A decision where you already know the right call but haven't said it out loud.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll say the fair thing out loud, or keep deliberating to avoid disappointing someone.

cards.title: The Voice Of Silence
cards.phrase: Universal intelligence flows through neural pathways of light
cards.meditation: Inhale silver starlight into your crown; exhale as cosmic consciousness cascades through every cell of your being.
cards.interpretation: Your mind is expanding beyond personal limitations. Trust the cosmic intelligence flowing through you as ancient knowing awakens in your awareness.
cards.grounded_supported: An answer arrives that didn't come from effortful thinking — it showed up after you stopped forcing it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Mental noise from trying to think your way to a conclusion that actually needs quiet, not more analysis.
cards.grounded_where: A problem you've been overthinking that would resolve faster with less analysis, not more.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let an answer arrive in quiet instead of forcing it through more analysis.

cards.title: The Crown Of Radiance
cards.phrase: Divine blueprints manifest through inner order
cards.meditation: Inhale through the geometric petals; exhale as universal patterns bloom naturally through your embodied presence
cards.interpretation: Sacred order and natural beauty are merging through you. Allow divine patterns to express themselves organically as you trust your innate perfection.
cards.grounded_supported: A structure or plan you've been building starts to hold its own shape, without you having to force every piece into place.
cards.grounded_resisted: Over-engineering — adding more rules and controls to something that would work better if you let it breathe.
cards.grounded_where: A system, routine, or plan you keep tightening instead of trusting.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can trust a structure to hold, instead of adding more control to feel safe.

cards.title: The Lotus of Renewal
cards.phrase: Purity emerges from the depths of experience
cards.meditation: Inhale golden sunlight into your heart lotus; exhale as each petal opens to reveal the unstained essence of your being
cards.interpretation: You are emerging from all experiences with greater wisdom and purity. Like the lotus, your consciousness rises untouched by the mud of worldly concerns.
cards.grounded_supported: You come out of a hard stretch changed, but recognizably yourself — the difficulty didn't cost you your core.
cards.grounded_resisted: Rushing to look 'healed' or 'over it' before you've actually processed what happened.
cards.grounded_where: The pressure to seem fine again faster than you actually are.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let recovery take the time it actually takes, instead of performing that you're already through it.

cards.title: The Pillar of Spirit
cards.phrase: Healing waters flow through channels of renewal
cards.meditation: Inhale cool emerald light through your spine; exhale as healing currents wash away all that no longer serves
cards.interpretation: Divine healing energy is flowing through you. Trust the cleansing process as old patterns dissolve and your authentic self emerges renewed.
cards.grounded_supported: An old pattern is loosening its grip — you notice yourself responding differently to something that used to trigger you automatically.
cards.grounded_resisted: Picking at an old wound in the name of 'healing it' rather than letting it settle on its own timeline.
cards.grounded_where: A recurring reaction (to criticism, rejection, a certain tone) that's slowly losing its charge.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let an old pattern fade on its own timeline instead of picking at it to speed things up.

cards.title: The Emerald Order
cards.phrase: Sacred geometry activates multilayer awareness
cards.meditation: Inhale into the ascending triangle; exhale through the descending triangle as your light body activates in perfect symmetry
cards.interpretation: Your multidimensional nature is activating. You are becoming a conscious vehicle of light, able to navigate all realms with clarity and purpose.
cards.grounded_supported: You can hold multiple views of a situation at once — your own, someone else's, the practical one — without losing your footing.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting lost switching between perspectives, unable to settle on what you actually think.
cards.grounded_where: A conflict or decision where you can see every side too clearly to commit to one.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold multiple perspectives without losing your own ability to commit to one.

cards.title: The Bridge Between Worlds
cards.phrase: Divine symmetry flows through the vertical spine of being
cards.meditation: Visualize twin lotus flowers blooming above and below your heart center, connected by a luminous thread of starlight that extends infinitely in both directions
cards.interpretation: You are the meeting point between earthly wisdom and cosmic consciousness. Your vertical alignment creates a channel for divine energy to flow through multiple dimensions of reality.
cards.grounded_supported: You're the one connecting two things that don't usually talk to each other — two teams, two people, two ideas — and it's working.
cards.grounded_resisted: Stretched too thin holding a connection together that both sides should be maintaining themselves.
cards.grounded_where: Being the go-between in a relationship or project that's exhausting you.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold a connection between two people or things without exhausting yourself doing both sides' work.

cards.title: The Root Of Shadow
cards.phrase: In the marriage of opposing forces, wholeness is born
cards.meditation: Feel warmth rising from your root while coolness descends from your crown, meeting in perfect equilibrium at your solar plexus
cards.interpretation: You are learning to embrace both light and shadow, fire and water, earth and sky. True spiritual maturity comes from integrating rather than rejecting any aspect of existence.
cards.grounded_supported: Finally admitting a need, an anger, or a desire you'd disowned, and finding it doesn't destroy you.
cards.grounded_resisted: Projecting the disowned half onto someone else — a sudden, disproportionate reaction to a person or situation that's really about you.
cards.grounded_where: A conflict that feels bigger than the actual disagreement.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can own a disowned part of yourself instead of reacting to it when you see it in someone else.

cards.title: The Tree Of Emanations
cards.phrase: Each possibility contains the seed of all others
cards.meditation: See yourself at the center of an infinite matrix of light, each intersection representing a choice point that connects to unlimited possibilities
cards.interpretation: You stand at the convergence of infinite timelines and possibilities. Every decision you make ripples through the fabric of reality, creating new patterns of potential.
cards.grounded_supported: You take a decision seriously because you can feel it matters, without needing to see every downstream consequence first.
cards.grounded_resisted: Decision paralysis from trying to map every possible outcome before you'll commit to any of them.
cards.grounded_where: A choice you're overanalyzing because you're afraid of the ripple effects.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can commit to a choice without needing to map every consequence first.

cards.title: The Spine of Crystalline Wisdom
cards.phrase: Sacred geometry flows through the channel of your being
cards.meditation: Envision each vertebra as a luminous geometric form, stacked in perfect harmony, conducting divine light from earth to cosmos
cards.interpretation: Your spiritual path follows the architecture of universal law. Each level of consciousness you attain becomes a stable platform for the next stage of awakening.
cards.grounded_supported: Real progress — the kind you can build on, not the kind that has to be redone later.
cards.grounded_resisted: Skipping the boring, foundational step because the exciting next stage feels more urgent.
cards.grounded_where: A shortcut you're tempted to take that would cost you more time later.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll do the unglamorous foundational step, or skip to the exciting part and pay for it later.

cards.title: The Sacred Polarity
cards.phrase: The spectrum of creation lives in your energy centers
cards.meditation: Draw each color of the spectrum up through your chakras, creating a vertical rainbow that bridges your earthly and divine nature
cards.interpretation: You contain the full spectrum of cosmic energy within your being. By balancing and integrating all aspects of yourself, you become a living bridge between dimensions.
cards.grounded_supported: The parts of you that seem opposite — ambitious and content, driven and at peace — turn out to need each other, not cancel each other out.
cards.grounded_resisted: Picking a side of yourself to suppress because you think you can only be one way.
cards.grounded_where: Feeling like you have to choose between two traits people expect you to pick one of.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold two real sides of yourself at once instead of suppressing one to seem consistent.

cards.title: The Radiant Crown
cards.phrase: Where two circles meet, the eternal mystery is revealed
cards.meditation: Feel your individual consciousness expanding until it overlaps with universal consciousness, creating a sacred space of unity in the intersection
cards.interpretation: You are discovering the place where your personal identity meets cosmic consciousness. In this sacred intersection, the illusion of separation dissolves into the truth of interconnected being.
cards.grounded_supported: A moment where your personal want and something bigger than you actually line up — you don't have to sacrifice one for the other.
cards.grounded_resisted: Assuming your own needs are automatically in conflict with what's good for the people around you.
cards.grounded_where: A choice you've been framing as 'selfish vs. selfless' when it might not be either.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether your own good and someone else's good are really as opposed as you've been assuming.

cards.title: The Veil of Maya
cards.phrase: What melts away reveals what cannot be destroyed
cards.meditation: Visualize golden honey-light dripping from the edges of your awareness, dissolving all that is temporary while the eternal star at your center grows brighter
cards.interpretation: Through surrender, the false self dissolves to reveal the imperishable truth within. What appears as loss is actually liberation.
cards.grounded_supported: Losing an illusion about a person, plan, or version of yourself — and discovering what's left is more solid, not less.
cards.grounded_resisted: Clinging to a story that's already stopped being true because the truth feels like a loss.
cards.grounded_where: A belief about someone or something you're holding onto past its expiration date.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let go of a story you've outgrown, even though the truth costs you something.

cards.title: The Sphere of Harmony
cards.phrase: Balancing forces, the sphere of harmony aligned with cosmic devotion
cards.meditation: See eight points of amber light surrounding a sapphire star in your heart space, each point representing a facet of wisdom integrating into wholeness
cards.interpretation: You are the central stillness around which all sacred patterns organize themselves. Perfect order emerges naturally when you align with your center.
cards.grounded_supported: Things around you settle down not because you controlled them, but because you stopped reacting to every fluctuation.
cards.grounded_resisted: Trying to manage everyone else's mood or behavior in order to feel calm yourself.
cards.grounded_where: A chaotic situation you keep trying to fix by managing other people instead of your own center.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can find your own calm without needing to manage everyone else's state first.

cards.title: The Prismatic Stream
cards.phrase: Flowing current embodying divine glory and destiny
cards.meditation: Hold the image of a pristine white flower within transparent walls that bend but never break, feeling yourself as both the flower and the protecting vessel
cards.interpretation: True strength lies not in rigidity but in the fluid grace that shields what is pure. Flexibility preserves what appears most fragile.
cards.grounded_supported: Bending instead of holding a rigid position turns out to be the thing that actually protects what matters.
cards.grounded_resisted: Digging in on a position out of pride, even after it's clearly not serving you anymore.
cards.grounded_where: An argument or stance you're maintaining mostly because backing down feels like losing.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can release a position you're only still holding because backing down feels like losing.

cards.title: The Temporal Mirage
cards.phrase: Time as both the binding illusion and eternal essence
cards.meditation: Sense golden fire spiraling upward from your base while crystalline patterns anchor below, with your awareness as the narrow passage between realms
cards.interpretation: You are the sacred vessel through which infinite potential flows into manifest form. Time becomes your ally when you rest in the eternal present.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop measuring the situation by how long it's taking and start actually being in it — which changes how it feels entirely.
cards.grounded_resisted: Anxious clock-watching — treating the present as only valuable for what it leads to next.
cards.grounded_where: A slow process (healing, waiting on a decision, building something) you keep rushing in your head.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can be present in a slow process instead of measuring it only by when it'll be over.

cards.title: The Alchemical Hourglass
cards.phrase: Surrender to the sacred constriction that births immortal essence
cards.meditation: You become the living vessel of temporal alchemy. Inhale as the molten gold of your accumulated experiences pools in the lower chamber of your being; hold as time itself crystallizes, compressing aeons of soul-learning into a single diamond moment of becoming.
cards.interpretation: You have entered the sacred ordeal of the narrow gate—the alchemical crucible where base consciousness transmutes into the philosopher's stone of pure awareness. True transformation happens not in expansion but in compression, not in accumulation but in distillation.
cards.grounded_supported: A necessary narrowing — fewer options, tighter constraints — that actually produces something more concentrated and real than you had before.
cards.grounded_resisted: Fighting the constriction, trying to keep every option open when the moment is asking you to commit to one.
cards.grounded_where: A season of reduced options (financial, time, scope) that's forcing focus.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can accept a narrowing of options as useful focus rather than fighting it.

cards.title: The Radiant Flame
cards.phrase: Central fire bursting outward as divine illumination
cards.meditation: Feel six streams of colored light flowing outward from your heart like petals of living fire, each carrying a different quality of love
cards.interpretation: Your essence is the seed from which all possibilities blossom. The sacred fire within you illuminates countless paths.
cards.grounded_supported: One clear source of motivation is enough — you don't need five reasons, just one real one, to keep going.
cards.grounded_resisted: Spreading your energy across too many reasons and directions until none of them feel compelling anymore.
cards.grounded_where: A goal that's lost its pull because you've added too many justifications for it.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether one real reason is enough to keep going, instead of needing five justifications to stay motivated.

cards.title: The Primordial Spark
cards.phrase: The divine spark of wisdom, origin of creation and consciousness
cards.meditation: Trace a golden spiral from your core outward through layers of honeyed geometry, feeling the ancient wisdom encoded in each turn
cards.interpretation: You are the living formula through which universal intelligence expresses its perfect design. Divine wisdom unfolds naturally through you.
cards.grounded_supported: An idea arrives whole, before you've had time to overthink it — and it's worth trusting exactly because it came that fast.
cards.grounded_resisted: Talking yourself out of a good instinct because it didn't come with a fully worked-out plan attached.
cards.grounded_where: A gut call you're second-guessing because you can't yet explain why it's right.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll trust an instinct that arrived fast, instead of requiring it to justify itself first.

cards.title: The New Order
cards.phrase: Order and renewal through divine truth.
cards.meditation: Feel golden fire rising from your base through your spine, blooming into a lotus crown while sacred hexagons anchor the energy in crystalline precision
cards.interpretation: You are the axis where earthly fire meets celestial flowering, contained within perfect geometric harmony. Truth and renewal flow through your being.
cards.grounded_supported: An old structure gets replaced by something more honest — not necessarily bigger or better, just truer to what's actually happening.
cards.grounded_resisted: Keeping an outdated system, rule, or role going out of habit, past the point it still fits.
cards.grounded_where: A routine, agreement, or role that technically still exists but doesn't reflect reality anymore.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll retire a structure that no longer fits, instead of keeping it out of habit.

cards.title: The Holy Fire
cards.phrase: The eternal flame as mediator between spirit and matter.
cards.meditation: Visualize three flowing ribbons of colored light—blue, gold, and orange—spiraling together into a single brilliant point at your heart center
cards.interpretation: All apparent divisions dissolve when traced back to their common luminous origin within you. The holy fire bridges all dimensions.
cards.grounded_supported: You find the thing two people (or two parts of your life) actually have in common, underneath where they seem to disagree.
cards.grounded_resisted: Assuming two sides of a conflict are fundamentally incompatible rather than looking for the shared root.
cards.grounded_where: A disagreement that might be more about miscommunication than actual opposing goals.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll look for the shared root under a conflict instead of assuming both sides are simply incompatible.

cards.title: The Phoenix Gateway
cards.phrase: Flame rising as the strength of divine sovereignty
cards.meditation: See yourself as the winged flame at the center of spiraling ornamental patterns, rising through cycles of death and rebirth with infinite grace
cards.interpretation: You are the immortal consciousness that uses every ending as a doorway to greater magnificence. Divine sovereignty rises through transformation.
cards.grounded_supported: Something ending clears the way for something better — not despite the ending, but because of it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Grieving an ending so hard you miss the opening it created.
cards.grounded_where: A closed door (job, relationship, plan) you haven't yet let yourself see as also an opening.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see the opening an ending created, instead of staying fixed on what it cost.

cards.title: The Inner Compass
cards.phrase: The inner guidance of humility and attunement.
cards.meditation: Place yourself at the center of a color wheel, feeling each hue as a different quality of your being, all rotating around your essential colorless clarity
cards.interpretation: You contain the full spectrum of existence while remaining the pure awareness that witnesses all colors. Right mind guides you true.
cards.grounded_supported: You can take in a lot of conflicting input — advice, opinions, data — and still know what you actually think.
cards.grounded_resisted: Losing your own read on a situation because you've absorbed too many other people's opinions about it.
cards.grounded_where: A decision where you've asked too many people for input and lost your own signal.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold onto your own read on something after taking in a lot of other people's opinions.

cards.title: The Cosmic Cycle
cards.phrase: The cycles of time reflecting divine perfection.
cards.meditation: Trace the golden spiral outward from your heart, feeling each turn as an expansion of love following the universe's most fundamental pattern
cards.interpretation: Your love grows according to the same divine proportions that shape galaxies and flowers. Wholeness unfolds in perfect timing.
cards.grounded_supported: Something you're building (a relationship, a project) is developing at its own natural pace, and that pace turns out to be right.
cards.grounded_resisted: Trying to force a timeline onto something that has its own rhythm — rushing intimacy, rushing a launch, rushing trust.
cards.grounded_where: A relationship or project you keep wanting to speed up.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let something grow at its own pace instead of forcing your timeline onto it.

cards.title: The Solar Storm
cards.phrase: From stillness, infinite movement; from movement, perfect stillness
cards.meditation: Feel yourself as the calm center while waves of fiery energy ripple outward in all directions, knowing the chaos and peace are one
cards.interpretation: You are the serene eye within every storm of transformation. The immortal light within remains constant through all change.
cards.grounded_supported: You stay steady in the middle of real disruption — not unaffected, but not thrown either.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting swept into the chaos around you, losing your own center because everyone else has lost theirs.
cards.grounded_where: A high-stress period (layoffs, a move, a crisis) where everyone's reacting and you're deciding whether to join them.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can stay steady while real disruption happens around you, without losing your own center.

cards.title: The Crystalline Silence
cards.phrase: In the geometry of stillness, all questions find their answer
cards.meditation: Rest in the transparent geometric forms surrounding a luminous center, feeling the profound peace that exists before thought arises
cards.interpretation: You are the silent space where all sacred patterns naturally arrange themselves. Divine listening reveals perfect clarity.
cards.grounded_supported: An answer arrives in the quiet, not the noise — after you stop actively hunting for it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Filling silence with more research, more talking, more analysis because sitting with the unknown feels unbearable.
cards.grounded_where: A question you keep trying to solve by adding more input instead of subtracting noise.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can sit with an unanswered question instead of drowning it in more research and talk.

cards.title: The Integrity
cards.phrase: Guardian of vows and the embodiment of trust
cards.meditation: Feel golden energy spiraling up through your physical form while triangular patterns of light emanate from every cell
cards.interpretation: Your human form is the sacred chalice through which infinite awareness pours itself into manifestation. Truth-keeping sanctifies the body.
cards.grounded_supported: Keeping a commitment costs you something real right now — and you do it anyway, and it matters more because it was hard.
cards.grounded_resisted: Quietly renegotiating your own standards to make a broken promise feel technically kept.
cards.grounded_where: A commitment (to a person, a deadline, yourself) that's gotten inconvenient to keep.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll keep a commitment when it's actually costing you something, not just when it's easy.

cards.title: The Illuminating Consciousness
cards.phrase: Radiance awakening the higher vision.
cards.meditation: Sit in serene meditation posture while feeling ornate patterns of wisdom-fire radiating from your crown and third eye
cards.interpretation: Your deepest peace and your most radiant activity are the same undivided awareness expressing itself. Flowing light awakens vision.
cards.grounded_supported: Rest and action stop feeling like opposites — you can be productive without abandoning your calm, or calm without going passive.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating rest as something you have to earn, or productivity as something that requires burning your peace to get.
cards.grounded_where: A pattern of overworking to 'deserve' downtime, or resting guiltily instead of fully.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether rest and effort can coexist for you without one having to be earned by the other.

cards.title: The Star Navigator
cards.phrase: Striving upward through trials with noble thought
cards.meditation: See yourself within geometric protection while a guiding star reflects perfectly between sky and water, inner and outer
cards.interpretation: The same light that guides you through outer journeys is the inner wisdom that illuminates your path home. Good mind aspires upward through trials.
cards.grounded_supported: A difficult stretch is actually where the real learning is happening — not a detour from your path, but part of it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating hardship as proof you're on the wrong track, when it might just be the track being hard.
cards.grounded_where: A challenge you're framing as a sign to quit rather than a sign you're doing something real.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can stay on a path through a hard stretch instead of reading the difficulty as a wrong turn.

cards.title: The Cosmic Harbor
cards.phrase: The stillness of waters mirroring cosmic order.
cards.meditation: Float in peaceful waters while twelve golden suns encircle you above, each one awakening a different aspect of your cosmic nature
cards.interpretation: You are the still center where all cycles of time and experience find their perfect reflection. Sacred waters mirror cosmic order.
cards.grounded_supported: You reflect a situation back accurately instead of reacting to it — becoming the calm one people check their own reaction against.
cards.grounded_resisted: Absorbing everyone else's emotional weather as if it's your own, losing your separate footing.
cards.grounded_where: Being around someone whose mood tends to become your mood.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can stay separate from someone else's emotional weather instead of absorbing it as your own.

cards.title: The Sacred Flame Rise
cards.phrase: From deep earth, through dark water, into bright stars
cards.meditation: Feel roots in earth, flow through water, burst into flame, and expand into starlight while geometric forms provide sacred structure
cards.interpretation: You are the eternal flame that transforms through all elements while maintaining its essential luminous nature. Sacred guardianship protects the covenant.
cards.grounded_supported: You pass through a hard phase changed but intact — the difficulty didn't erase who you are, it revealed it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Bracing so hard against a hard season that you come out of it more rigid, not more resilient.
cards.grounded_where: A prolonged difficulty (financial, physical, relational) you're gritting your teeth through instead of moving with.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can move through a long hardship without hardening so much that you lose your flexibility.

cards.title: The Source of Guidance
cards.phrase: The supreme guiding intelligence at the center of all.
cards.meditation: Stand in the peaceful center while swirling energies move around you, feeling the golden triangle as your stable foundation amidst all change
cards.interpretation: You are the unchanging geometric truth that remains constant through every transformation. Supreme guidance centers all movement.
cards.grounded_supported: One clear internal reference point keeps you oriented even while everything around you is in motion.
cards.grounded_resisted: Losing your center trying to keep track of every moving piece, every opinion, every variable.
cards.grounded_where: A complex situation with too many moving parts where you've lost your own bottom line.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold one clear internal reference point while a complex situation has many moving parts.

cards.title: The Inner Sanctuary
cards.phrase: In the depths of stillness, golden light awakens
cards.meditation: Feel yourself as luminous presence within the cave of your heart, protected and nourished by ancient wisdom
cards.interpretation: True illumination begins in the sacred space within, where your essence glows independent of outer circumstances. Divine listening guards the inner temple.
cards.grounded_supported: You find something steady inside yourself that doesn't depend on your circumstances improving first.
cards.grounded_resisted: Waiting for external conditions to be right before you'll let yourself feel okay.
cards.grounded_where: Putting your peace on hold until a situation resolves, instead of finding some now.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can find steadiness now instead of waiting for your circumstances to improve first.

cards.title: The Divine Descent
cards.phrase: Heaven's light seeks the prepared vessel
cards.meditation: Stand open as radiant beams of wisdom pour through you, transforming darkness into luminous understanding
cards.interpretation: When you align with higher purpose, divine light naturally flows through you to illuminate the world. The contest between darkness and good mind refines the soul.
cards.grounded_supported: You're ready for an opportunity or responsibility right when it shows up — the preparation you didn't know you were doing pays off.
cards.grounded_resisted: Feeling unprepared for something that's actually well within your capacity, and hesitating because of that feeling rather than the facts.
cards.grounded_where: An opportunity you're talking yourself out of being ready for.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll trust that you're actually ready for something, instead of deferring to a feeling of unpreparedness.

cards.title: The Axis Of Light
cards.phrase: All directions converge at the center of being
cards.meditation: Rest at the intersection of all sacred geometries, feeling yourself as the still point around which all creation revolves
cards.interpretation: You are both the navigator and the destination, the seeker and the center that all paths ultimately lead to. Cosmic covenant maintains perfect alignment.
cards.grounded_supported: Different parts of a complicated situation actually point toward the same underlying answer once you stop treating them as separate problems.
cards.grounded_resisted: Solving pieces of a situation in isolation, missing that they're all connected to one root issue.
cards.grounded_where: A problem with several 'symptoms' that might actually be one root cause.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see that several separate-seeming problems are actually connected to one root.

cards.title: The Shards Of Revelation
cards.phrase: From unity comes infinite creative expression
cards.meditation: Witness your consciousness fracturing into countless brilliant facets, each one reflecting the whole from a unique angle
cards.interpretation: Enlightenment doesn't diminish you into oneness—it explodes you into infinite creative possibilities. Justice reveals truth through all perspectives.
cards.grounded_supported: Something you thought was a single answer turns out to have several valid versions — and that's expansion, not confusion.
cards.grounded_resisted: Anxiety from realizing there's more than one 'right' way forward, when you wanted one clear answer.
cards.grounded_where: A decision where multiple options are genuinely good, and the multiplicity itself feels stressful.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can tolerate more than one valid path forward without needing a single answer to feel settled.

cards.title: The Cosmic Weaver
cards.phrase: Mind dissolves into the fabric of space itself
cards.meditation: Feel your individual form becoming a constellation of light, your thoughts transforming into geometric patterns across the cosmos
cards.interpretation: The ultimate meditation is recognizing yourself as both the weaver and the pattern in the infinite tapestry of existence. Divine wisdom writes itself through creation.
cards.grounded_supported: You see your own part in a pattern clearly enough to actually change it, instead of just observing it from outside.
cards.grounded_resisted: Analyzing a pattern intellectually without ever stepping into what it would take to shift it.
cards.grounded_where: A dynamic (in a relationship, at work) you can describe perfectly but haven't changed your own role in.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll actually step into changing a pattern, not just get better at describing it.

cards.title: The Master of Elements
cards.phrase: Four sacred forms unite in the heart's pure fire
cards.meditation: Hold triangle, circle, and square in perfect equilibrium while divine light streams through your being
cards.interpretation: Master the fundamental forms of existence within yourself, and you become a bridge between earth and heaven. Divine lights order the elements.
cards.grounded_supported: You hold several different demands (practical, emotional, relational) at once without dropping any of them.
cards.grounded_resisted: Sacrificing one important area of life to over-serve another, then wondering why things feel unbalanced.
cards.grounded_where: A season where work, health, relationships, and rest are competing and one is quietly losing.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold several real demands at once without quietly sacrificing one to serve the others.

cards.title: The Cosmic Spiral
cards.phrase: In the great turning, stillness is found at the center
cards.meditation: Surrender to the vast spiraling energies while maintaining your inner luminous core unchanged
cards.interpretation: Let the universe whirl around you—your true nature remains the calm awareness witnessing all motion. Good mind unifies all principles.
cards.grounded_supported: You stay yourself while everything around you changes fast — the chaos doesn't have to become who you are.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting swept into reactive mode, making decisions from the speed of events rather than your own judgment.
cards.grounded_where: A fast-moving situation (a negotiation, a family crisis) where you're at risk of losing your own pace.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can keep your own pace and judgment while everything around you is moving fast.

cards.title: The Vesica Gateway
cards.phrase: Where two infinities meet, sacred geometry is born
cards.meditation: Position yourself at the crossing point of dual spiraling forces, becoming the living synthesis
cards.interpretation: You are the creative tension between opposites, the space where all polarities resolve into wholeness. Even entanglement serves the greater pattern.
cards.grounded_supported: Two things that seem like they're in conflict — two jobs, two people, two priorities — actually only need a little structure to coexist.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating a real tension as a forced choice when it's actually asking for a third option.
cards.grounded_where: A 'this or that' decision that might really be a 'both, structured differently' decision.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether a real tension actually needs a forced either/or, or whether a third option is available.

cards.title: The Geometric Dance
cards.phrase: Sacred forms cascade through the cosmic current
cards.meditation: Witness yourself as both the observer and the observed, while triangles and squares dance in divine order
cards.interpretation: Even in the most dynamic transformation, the essential geometric truths of existence remain constant. Each archangel embodies a force of creation.
cards.grounded_supported: You keep your core approach consistent even as the specific tactics have to change fast around you.
cards.grounded_resisted: Losing your principles under pressure to adapt quickly, changing not just your method but your values.
cards.grounded_where: A high-pressure situation where you're tempted to compromise something you'd normally hold firm on.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether your core approach stays intact under pressure, even while the specific tactics have to change.

cards.title: The Primal Triad
cards.phrase: Triangle ascends, circle embraces, square grounds all being
cards.meditation: Feel the fire triangle above, the water circle within, and the earth square below as one unified field
cards.interpretation: The three fundamental principles of creation exist in perfect harmony within your awakened consciousness. Past, present, and future converge in divine guidance.
cards.grounded_supported: Ambition, feeling, and practicality all get a say in a decision, instead of one overriding the other two.
cards.grounded_resisted: Making a call from only one register — pure logic, pure emotion, or pure ambition — and ignoring the other two.
cards.grounded_where: A decision you're making with only your head, or only your gut, when it needs both plus practicality.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let logic, feeling, and ambition all weigh in on a decision instead of just one of them.

cards.title: The Elemental Juggling
cards.phrase: What seems solid dissolves into living streams of light
cards.meditation: Watch fixed forms become liquid currents, understanding that all structure is energy in motion
cards.interpretation: True stability comes not from rigidity but from dancing perfectly with the eternal flow. Divine mediation balances all forces.
cards.grounded_supported: You move with a changing situation instead of trying to pin it down — adjusting the plan without losing the goal.
cards.grounded_resisted: Insisting on the original plan even after the situation underneath it has clearly shifted.
cards.grounded_where: A plan you're defending out of stubbornness more than because it's still the best option.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll adjust a plan to match a changed situation instead of defending the original version out of habit.

cards.title: The Cosmic Flute
cards.phrase: Seven lights ascend the spine of the cosmos
cards.meditation: Feel each energy center as a star in the constellation of your being, from root to crown
cards.interpretation: Your body is a map of the universe—awaken each center to know yourself as cosmic consciousness. Divine harmony keeps chaos at bay.
cards.grounded_supported: Different levels of a decision — practical, emotional, financial, relational — all get acknowledged instead of one dominating the rest.
cards.grounded_resisted: Making a big decision purely on one dimension (money, for instance) while ignoring what your body or gut is telling you.
cards.grounded_where: A major decision you're evaluating on spreadsheet logic alone.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll weigh a major decision on more than one dimension — not just the numbers, or just the feeling.

cards.title: Master Of Self
cards.phrase: Under double light, the soul spreads wings of flame
cards.meditation: Stand between two sources of divine radiance, arms outstretched, becoming a living conduit of celestial fire
cards.interpretation: When you embody both solar and lunar principles, you become the dancing flame that lights the world. Self-mastery through holy devotion.
cards.grounded_supported: You can be both firm and warm in the same conversation — structure and softness aren't actually in competition.
cards.grounded_resisted: Choosing one mode only — all boundary, no warmth, or all warmth, no boundary — because holding both feels harder.
cards.grounded_where: A conversation (a boundary, a difficult ask) where you're tempted to pick just toughness or just kindness.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold both firmness and warmth in the same moment instead of defaulting to only one.

cards.title: Focus Keeper
cards.phrase: One small flame contains the essence of the cosmic fire
cards.meditation: Hold perfect focus on the tiny light in your heart, knowing it contains the power to illuminate infinite worlds
cards.interpretation: Through single-pointed concentration, the smallest flame becomes the greatest illumination. Sacred fire burns steadily within.
cards.grounded_supported: One consistent daily practice does more for you than five scattered attempts at self-improvement.
cards.grounded_resisted: Starting and abandoning multiple habits or systems at once, none of them getting enough attention to stick.
cards.grounded_where: A stretch where you've started several new routines and none of them are sticking.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll give one practice sustained attention instead of starting several and finishing none.

cards.title: The Temple Gateway
cards.phrase: Through sacred architecture, consciousness finds its home
cards.meditation: Feel yourself seated in the temple of your own being, surrounded by pillars of living light
cards.interpretation: Every meditation creates sacred space—you are both the temple builder and the deity within. The luminous threshold determines ascent toward the higher realms.
cards.grounded_supported: You build something (a routine, a space, a way of working) that actually holds up under real use, not just in theory.
cards.grounded_resisted: Designing an elaborate system that looks good on paper but that you never actually follow.
cards.grounded_where: A plan, app, or system you've built but haven't actually used consistently.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether a system you've built actually gets used, or just exists as a good idea on paper.

cards.title: The Higher Intention
cards.phrase: Consciousness explodes into infinite spectrum of being
cards.meditation: Feel your awareness fracture into countless colors while remaining unified in brilliant radiance
cards.interpretation: The ultimate realization is seeing your one consciousness as the source of all diversity. Good Mind reveals the divine faculty of pure intention.
cards.grounded_supported: One core intention is enough to guide a lot of different decisions — you don't need a separate goal for every area of life.
cards.grounded_resisted: Chasing many disconnected goals at once, none of them clearly serving the thing you actually want most.
cards.grounded_where: A list of goals that don't obviously connect to a single underlying intention.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether your many goals are actually serving one real intention, or just scattering your effort.

cards.title: The Spinal Serpent
cards.phrase: Through the depths flows the golden thread of eternal wisdom
cards.meditation: Follow the serpentine flow of inner fire as it moves through the midnight ocean of consciousness
cards.interpretation: Within the darkness of the unconscious flows the luminous stream that connects you to all existence. The tension between deception and truth purifies the rising energy.
cards.grounded_supported: Something difficult from your past turns out to be the source of real insight now, not just baggage you're carrying.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating old pain as purely a burden, missing what it actually taught you that you now rely on.
cards.grounded_where: A past hardship you talk about only as damage, never as a source of capability.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see what an old hardship actually gave you, not just what it cost.

cards.title: Spatial Dance
cards.phrase: Each point of light is connected to every other
cards.meditation: See yourself as one star in an infinite constellation, your light both unique and inseparable from the whole
cards.interpretation: Individual enlightenment and universal consciousness are the same reality seen from different perspectives. The star-being battles chaos through rhythmic cycles.
cards.grounded_supported: A choice that seems small or personal turns out to affect more people than you expected — in a good way.
cards.grounded_resisted: Assuming your actions don't matter much beyond your own life, and disengaging because of it.
cards.grounded_where: A decision you're treating as low-stakes that others are actually paying attention to.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll take a seemingly small choice seriously, given that its effects may reach further than you assume.

cards.title: The Paisley Garden
cards.phrase: In endless patterns, the one becomes the many
cards.meditation: Trace the repeating motifs of consciousness as it creates infinite variations on the theme of unity
cards.interpretation: The divine delights in creating endless beautiful expressions of its single, simple truth. Dual currents merge in ultimate unity.
cards.grounded_supported: The same core value or idea shows up in very different areas of your life — and noticing that gives you more conviction, not less.
cards.grounded_resisted: Fragmenting your sense of purpose across too many different pursuits instead of recognizing the thread connecting them.
cards.grounded_where: Several different interests or projects that might actually be expressions of one underlying value.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see the one value connecting several different pursuits instead of experiencing them as scattered.

cards.title: Twisted Mind
cards.phrase: All paths interweave in the sacred knot of being
cards.meditation: Follow the interlacing strands of karma and dharma until you find they form one unbroken circle
cards.interpretation: What appears as complexity is the universe's way of tying itself into one perfect, inescapable embrace. False gods twist perception but truth ultimately prevails.
cards.grounded_supported: A confusing situation resolves once you stop trying to untangle every strand and just watch which way it's actually moving.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting lost in the complexity of a situation, mistaking confusion itself for a sign you're missing something important.
cards.grounded_where: An overly complicated situation (a negotiation, a family dynamic) that might be simpler than it feels.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether a confusing situation is actually as complicated as it feels, or simpler once you stop untangling every strand.

cards.title: The Dragon Current
cards.phrase: Through spiraling winds, the ancient wisdom rises
cards.meditation: Feel the serpentine energy of primordial consciousness ascending through layers of colorful manifestation
cards.interpretation: The most powerful spiritual forces move not in straight lines but in the organic spirals of natural wisdom. Unbridled passion must be channeled into ascending power.
cards.grounded_supported: Real change doesn't come from a straight, controlled effort but from letting the process move the way it naturally wants to.
cards.grounded_resisted: Forcing a linear plan onto something that keeps circling back and needs another pass, not a straight line.
cards.grounded_where: A goal you keep expecting to reach in a straight line that keeps looping instead.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let a process spiral and circle back instead of forcing it into a straight line.

cards.title: The Loving Exchange
cards.phrase: In giving and receiving, two become one light
cards.meditation: Feel the golden radiance that flows between souls when barriers dissolve in perfect loving presence
cards.interpretation: The highest meditation is the recognition of no separation between self and other, lover and beloved. The prophesied savior bridges mortal struggle and divine redemption .
cards.grounded_supported: A relationship or exchange feels mutual — you're not the only one giving, and it's not draining you.
cards.grounded_resisted: Over-giving in a relationship while quietly resenting the imbalance instead of naming it.
cards.grounded_where: A relationship (romantic, family, work) where the giving has become one-directional.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll name an imbalance in giving and receiving instead of quietly resenting it.

cards.title: The Solar Mandala
cards.phrase: From the eternal center, all light radiates outward
cards.meditation: Feel yourself as the central sun within ornate cosmic patterns, your essence flowing outward through infinite spiraling designs
cards.interpretation: You are both the source and the pattern—the unchanging center from which all beautiful complexity emerges. Guardian spirits honor deeds aligned with truth.
cards.grounded_supported: You stay recognizably yourself even as your life gets more complex — the center holds while more grows around it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Losing track of your own core identity as responsibilities and roles multiply around you.
cards.grounded_where: A busy season where you're not sure who you are outside of everything you're managing.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you stay recognizably yourself as your responsibilities and roles keep multiplying.

cards.title: Deception
cards.phrase: Softness guides the endless journey inward
cards.meditation: Follow the spiral's path with your awareness, moving slowly from outer edge to center, feeling each layer of tension dissolve
cards.interpretation: Growth unfolds naturally through patience rather than force. Trust the gradual process of inner awakening, even when seductive illusions attempt to mislead.
cards.grounded_supported: You let something develop slowly instead of forcing a quick resolution, and the patience turns out to be the right call.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting pulled toward a fast, appealing shortcut that isn't actually the real solution.
cards.grounded_where: A tempting quick fix you're considering instead of the slower, more solid option.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let the slower, real solution unfold instead of reaching for the appealing shortcut.

cards.title: The Fractal Dawn
cards.phrase: Clarity cuts through illusion's veil
cards.meditation: Visualize brilliant light refracting through crystalline structures within your mind, creating rainbow clarity
cards.interpretation: Mental precision and spiritual insight work together to reveal truth beyond appearances. The dawn fractal reflects eternal unfolding completeness.
cards.grounded_supported: You see through a confusing situation to what's actually happening — the fog lifts because you looked closer, not because you looked away.
cards.grounded_resisted: Accepting a comfortable but inaccurate read on a situation because the accurate one is less pleasant.
cards.grounded_where: A situation where the easy interpretation and the true one might not be the same.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll look closely enough to see what's actually happening, even if the comfortable reading is easier.

cards.title: The Eye Of the Eternal
cards.phrase: From the heart's eye, all perspectives unite
cards.meditation: Rest awareness at your heart center, allowing golden light to expand your inner vision in all directions
cards.interpretation: True wisdom sees from love's perspective, integrating multiple viewpoints into compassionate understanding. Divine vision perceives truth beyond all illusion.
cards.grounded_supported: You genuinely understand someone else's position, not just tolerate it — and that changes how you respond to them.
cards.grounded_resisted: Performing understanding of someone's view while privately still just waiting for your turn to disagree.
cards.grounded_where: A conflict where you've stopped actually listening and started just waiting to respond.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you're actually listening to someone's view, or just performing understanding while you wait to respond.

cards.title: The Sacred Convergence
cards.phrase: Where light meets light, transformation begins
cards.meditation: Feel streams of pure awareness converging at your crown, creating a fountain of luminous presence
cards.interpretation: Spiritual breakthroughs occur when different aspects of consciousness align in perfect harmony. The Holy Spirit shapes crystalline structure from chaos.
cards.grounded_supported: Two separate efforts or people finally combine into something neither could do alone — real collaboration, not just proximity.
cards.grounded_resisted: Working in parallel with someone without actually integrating your efforts, missing the value of real collaboration.
cards.grounded_where: A partnership or team effort that's more 'side by side' than actually combined.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll actually integrate your effort with someone else's, not just work alongside them.

cards.title: The Stellar Seed
cards.phrase: Movement and stillness create cosmic rhythm
cards.meditation: Sense yourself as both the dancing energy and the still center around which all movement flows
cards.interpretation: Life's highest expression balances active engagement with inner stillness. The Star Yazata plants celestial origins within terrestrial existence.
cards.grounded_supported: You can be fully active in your life and still have a still, quiet center that doesn't get swept up in the pace.
cards.grounded_resisted: Mistaking constant motion for meaning, filling every moment because stillness feels uncomfortable.
cards.grounded_where: A busy period where you haven't had a genuinely still moment in a while.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can hold a still center even in a period that's full of motion.

cards.title: The Spiral of Radiance
cards.phrase: In surrender, chaos becomes sacred order
cards.meditation: Allow all mental activity to swirl freely while maintaining peaceful awareness at the center
cards.interpretation: What appears chaotic from limited perspective reveals perfect order from expanded awareness. Best truth spirals through eternal law in motion.
cards.grounded_supported: Something that looks like a mess from inside it is actually organizing into something coherent — you just can't see the shape yet.
cards.grounded_resisted: Panicking at disorder that's actually just an early, unfinished stage of something that will make sense later.
cards.grounded_where: A messy in-progress situation (a project, a plan) you're judging before it's finished forming.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can trust that an unfinished, messy stage is still forming, not already failing.

cards.title: The Golden Vessel
cards.phrase: Receptivity shapes the container of wisdom
cards.meditation: Form a cup with your consciousness, ready to receive whatever wisdom wishes to flow through
cards.interpretation: Spiritual maturity involves becoming an empty, willing vessel for higher intelligence to work through. Sacred fire descends to purify and consecrate.
cards.grounded_supported: You let something be given to you — help, feedback, an opportunity — instead of insisting on doing it all yourself.
cards.grounded_resisted: Refusing help or input out of pride or self-reliance, even when accepting it would clearly serve you better.
cards.grounded_where: An offer of help or collaboration you're inclined to turn down out of habit.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll accept help or input instead of insisting on doing it alone out of pride.

cards.title: The Brewing Storm
cards.phrase: All paths lead to the same luminous source
cards.meditation: Trace golden threads connecting your heart to all beings, feeling the web of universal love
cards.interpretation: Individual awakening serves the awakening of the whole; separation is an illusion of limited perception. Divine wind carries the breath of the unseen between realms.
cards.grounded_supported: Something you're going through personally turns out to matter beyond just you — your process affects a bigger picture.
cards.grounded_resisted: Feeling like your personal struggles are irrelevant or too small to matter in a wider context.
cards.grounded_where: Private work (on yourself, your health, your habits) you've been treating as disconnected from anything bigger.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see your private effort as mattering beyond just your own life.

cards.title: Verdant Emanation
cards.phrase: The heart's fire purifies with gentle power
cards.meditation: Feel green light radiating from your heart, healing and harmonizing all it touches
cards.interpretation: Love's transformative power works through compassion rather than destruction. The green flourishing essence resists decay and guards eternal life.
cards.grounded_supported: A gentle approach actually works better than a forceful one — patience and warmth get further than pressure.
cards.grounded_resisted: Pushing hard on a person or situation that would respond better to a softer touch.
cards.grounded_where: A relationship or negotiation where you're applying more pressure than the situation needs.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether a gentler approach might actually work better than the pressure you're currently applying.

cards.title: Continuity
cards.phrase: Layer upon layer, beauty has no end
cards.meditation: Witness consciousness opening like an eternal flower, each petal revealing deeper dimensions
cards.interpretation: Spiritual growth is an endless deepening rather than a destination to reach. Infinite time sustains both the seen and unseen through eternal duration.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop expecting a finish line and start finding satisfaction in the ongoing process itself.
cards.grounded_resisted: Frustration at a lack of a clear endpoint, treating an ongoing practice as a failed project instead of a continuing one.
cards.grounded_where: A long-term practice (health, skill, relationship) you're judging by 'are we done yet' instead of its own terms.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can find satisfaction in an ongoing practice without needing it to reach a finish line.

cards.title: The Goddess Within
cards.phrase: In joyful play, opposites find harmony
cards.meditation: Feel different aspects of yourself dancing together in colorful celebration of wholeness
cards.interpretation: Integration involves celebrating rather than suppressing the full spectrum of human experience. The waters of purity hold reflection and divine potential.
cards.grounded_supported: You let yourself enjoy something without needing to justify or explain the enjoyment — play as legitimate, not indulgent.
cards.grounded_resisted: Suppressing a genuinely joyful or playful impulse because it doesn't feel 'productive' or serious enough.
cards.grounded_where: Something fun you've been talking yourself out of because it doesn't seem important enough to prioritize.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let yourself enjoy something without first proving it's productive enough to deserve the time.

cards.title: The Celestial Expansion
cards.phrase: In flowing rhythm, wave and ocean unite
cards.meditation: Merge completely with the breath's natural flow, dissolving the boundary between breather and breathing
cards.interpretation: The simplest practices often yield the deepest realizations; sophistication serves simplicity. Good Mind expands as divine wisdom throughout creation.
cards.grounded_supported: A simple approach turns out to work better than the complicated one you were building — you didn't need all the extra machinery.
cards.grounded_resisted: Adding unnecessary complexity to a problem that actually has a straightforward answer.
cards.grounded_where: A plan or system you've overengineered relative to what the situation actually needs.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether the simple version of a plan might actually be enough, without the extra complexity you've added.

cards.title: The Ascendant
cards.phrase: Through the flame of transformation, new life emerges
cards.meditation: Feel old patterns dissolving in inner fire while new possibilities take shape in the flames
cards.interpretation: Spiritual death and rebirth are continuous processes rather than one-time events. The sun ever-rises, victorious symbol of ascent and illumination.
cards.grounded_supported: Something in you is genuinely different after a hard passage — not performing change, actually changed.
cards.grounded_resisted: Declaring yourself 'past' something before you've actually processed it, skipping ahead to the after-story.
cards.grounded_where: A difficult chapter you're eager to call finished before it fully is.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you've actually processed a hard chapter, or you're just eager to call it finished.

cards.title: The Arrows of Deception
cards.phrase: In chaos, infinite possibility awaits
cards.meditation: Rest in spacious awareness as thoughts and sensations arise and dissolve like meteors in vast sky
cards.interpretation: Periods of confusion often precede breakthrough moments; uncertainty can be a doorway. Forces of falsehood attack with sharp illusions.
cards.grounded_supported: A confusing, unsettled period turns out to be the setup for a real breakthrough, not just noise.
cards.grounded_resisted: Reading confusion as a sign of failure, when it might just be the discomfort before clarity.
cards.grounded_where: A muddled stretch (in a decision, a relationship, a project) you're taking as a bad sign.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can read a confusing stretch as the discomfort before clarity, not proof that something's wrong.

cards.title: The Flowing Veil
cards.phrase: Strength bends without breaking, flows without losing form
cards.meditation: Embody both mountain-like stability and water-like adaptability simultaneously
cards.interpretation: True strength lies not in rigidity but in the capacity to remain centered while adapting to circumstances. Divine waters conceal and reveal truth in equal measure.
cards.grounded_supported: You adjust your approach without losing your core position — flexible tactics, same underlying stance.
cards.grounded_resisted: Either rigidly refusing to adapt at all, or caving completely and losing your actual position.
cards.grounded_where: A situation demanding some flexibility where you're worried adapting means giving in entirely.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can adapt your approach without losing the underlying position you actually hold.

cards.title: The Fractal Infinity
cards.phrase: From center to circumference, love radiates perfectly
cards.meditation: Feel your heart as the center of an infinite mandala, with love flowing out in all direction
cards.interpretation: A truly open heart becomes an organizing principle that brings harmony to all aspects of life. Boundless time unfolds infinite patterns beyond comprehension.
cards.grounded_supported: One genuine act of care ends up shaping a lot more than you expected — warmth turns out to be structurally useful, not just nice.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating kindness or openness as separate from 'real' strategy, missing how much it actually organizes outcomes.
cards.grounded_where: A situation where you're being strategic and calculating instead of trusting that genuine care would work better.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether genuine care might actually be more effective here than the strategy you're leaning on instead.

cards.title: The Lightning Tree
cards.phrase: Sudden illumination branches through all understanding
cards.meditation: Be ready for sudden insights that can restructure your entire understanding in a moment
cards.interpretation: Enlightenment can be both gradual growth and sudden revelation; both paths serve awakening. Sacred fire breaks through impurities in the testing flame.
cards.grounded_supported: A sudden realization changes how you see something you'd been circling for a while — not gradual, just clear all at once.
cards.grounded_resisted: Dismissing a sudden insight because it didn't arrive the slow, deliberate way you expected understanding to come.
cards.grounded_where: A flash of clarity about something you're tempted to second-guess because it came too easily.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll trust a sudden insight, even though it didn't arrive the slow way you expected.

cards.title: The Moonlit Lotus
cards.phrase: In darkness, the flower of consciousness blooms eternal
cards.meditation: Feel yourself as a golden lotus floating in the vast night sky, rooted in stillness, open to infinity
cards.interpretation: The deepest spiritual flowering often occurs in life's darkest moments; suffering can be the soil of wisdom. The moon reflects purity and cyclic renewal.
cards.grounded_supported: Something genuinely good is developing during a hard time — not despite the difficulty, but somehow through it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Assuming a hard period has nothing to offer, missing what's actually forming underneath the difficulty.
cards.grounded_where: A rough stretch you've written off as purely bad, without looking for what it's building.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can look for what's actually forming inside a hard period instead of writing the whole thing off.

cards.title: The Triumph of Light
cards.phrase: From the abyss, the luminous lotus blooms
cards.meditation: Envision a radiant lotus rising from the depths, each petal glowing with rainbow fire. Feel it open within your chest, revealing the hidden light of your being
cards.interpretation: Out of the deepest shadow, your essence blossoms in color and light—a reminder that beauty emerges from the unseen depths. Divine truth inevitably triumphs over darkness.
cards.grounded_supported: Something good genuinely comes out of the worst part of a hard experience — not a silver lining you invented, an actual result.
cards.grounded_resisted: Rushing to find the silver lining before you've let the hard part actually be hard.
cards.grounded_where: A difficult experience you're pressuring yourself to already see the positive side of.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let the hard part actually be hard before you go looking for the lesson in it.

cards.title: The Primordial Egg
cards.phrase: In stillness, all worlds are held in potential
cards.meditation: Visualize the great cosmic egg suspended in the void. Rest in its silence, knowing all creation stirs within its boundless shell
cards.interpretation: Within the seed of silence lies infinite possibility; to dwell in this mystery is to touch the source of creation. The world-egg holds the first mingling of light and darkness.
cards.grounded_supported: You let a plan stay unformed a little longer, because it isn't ready to be decided yet — and that's the right call, not indecision.
cards.grounded_resisted: Forcing premature clarity onto something that needs more time to take shape.
cards.grounded_where: An early idea or relationship you're pressuring yourself to define too soon.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let something stay unformed a while longer instead of forcing premature clarity onto it.

cards.title: The Flight of Spirit
cards.phrase: Wings of light lift the soul beyond the abyss
