cards.meditation: Imagine luminous birds of spirit rising from the depths. Feel your inner essence lifting with them, carried on currents of grace
cards.interpretation: Liberation comes when you release heaviness; your spirit remembers its wings and takes flight. The eternal soul rises guided across the threshold toward higher realms.
cards.grounded_supported: You set down something heavy you'd been carrying out of habit — a grudge, an old identity, an obligation — and genuinely feel lighter.
cards.grounded_resisted: Holding onto a burden because letting go of it feels like it would mean it didn't matter.
cards.grounded_where: Something (a resentment, a role, a possession) you keep carrying past its usefulness.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can set down a burden you're only still carrying because letting go feels like it erases its meaning.

cards.title: The Bridge of Radiance
cards.phrase: Light spans the chasm, and the soul crosses
cards.meditation: See a bridge of golden light before you. With each breath, step across, guided by the radiant guardian that soars above
cards.interpretation: Every crossing demands courage; the bridge of light appears when you trust your inner guide. Recognition dawns that the spark within is of the Wise Lord Himself.
cards.grounded_supported: You make the harder, more honest move — a real conversation, a real ask — instead of the safer, quieter one.
cards.grounded_resisted: Avoiding a necessary but uncomfortable step because the safe, familiar option is right there.
cards.grounded_where: A conversation or decision you're putting off because the comfortable option is easier.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll take the harder, more honest step instead of the safe, familiar one sitting right there.

cards.title: The Solar Fountain
cards.phrase: The golden source overflows into creation
cards.meditation: Envision the sun pouring its luminous streams downward, filling you with radiant vitality. Feel yourself as both vessel and channel
cards.interpretation: Divine abundance flows endlessly; when you align, you become the fountain through which light nourishes the world. Divine Glory streams as cosmic radiant power.
cards.grounded_supported: Generosity from you comes back around, sometimes from a completely different direction than you gave it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Giving from a place of depletion, running yourself dry trying to be generous without refilling first.
cards.grounded_where: A pattern of giving (time, money, energy) faster than it's being replenished.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you're refilling yourself enough to keep giving, instead of giving from a place that's already dry.

cards.title: The Crown of Absoluteness
cards.phrase: Order and harmony shine in sacred design
cards.meditation: Gaze inward at the crystalline star of light, its geometry unfolding with each breath. Rest within its perfect symmetry
cards.interpretation: True balance arises when your inner design resonates with cosmic order. You are a living mandala. The infinite crown emanates all from the Absolute beyond duality.
cards.grounded_supported: Your outer life (schedule, environment, commitments) actually starts to match your internal values, instead of contradicting them.
cards.grounded_resisted: Living in a way that doesn't reflect what you actually care about, and feeling the friction of that gap.
cards.grounded_where: A mismatch between your stated priorities and how your actual time gets spent.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether your actual daily life reflects what you say you value, or quietly contradicts it.

cards.title: The Mind Unbound
cards.phrase: Infinite streams weave the path of ascent
cards.meditation: Imagine flowing currents of radiant light weaving upward through your being, reconnecting you with the greater cosmic flow
cards.interpretation: Life is a stream of eternal energy; when you surrender to the current, you rise effortlessly. Good Mind serves truth in liberated thought.
cards.grounded_supported: Letting go of controlling every detail actually gets you where you're going faster than gripping tighter would.
cards.grounded_resisted: Micromanaging a process that would move better if you trusted it more and controlled it less.
cards.grounded_where: A project or plan you're over-managing instead of letting develop with less interference.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can trust a process enough to control it less, even though that feels riskier.

cards.title: The Living Book
cards.phrase: Each page reveals the hidden flame
cards.meditation: Visualize a cosmic book opening before you. Each translucent page reveals a deeper flame, the record of your soul's wisdom
cards.interpretation: Your path is written in light; every step unfolds the next chapter in divine order. The living scripture of truth is carried within all creation.
cards.grounded_supported: You don't need the whole plan mapped out — the next right step is visible, and that's enough for now.
cards.grounded_resisted: Refusing to move until you can see the entire path, stuck because step three isn't clear yet.
cards.grounded_where: A long-term goal you haven't started because you can't see the whole route yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can take the next visible step without needing the entire path mapped out first.

cards.title: The Golden Thread
cards.phrase: The thread of eternity weaves through the void
cards.meditation: See a golden filament stretching across the cosmos, connecting all worlds. Feel yourself woven into its eternal pattern
cards.interpretation: The golden thread binds all existence; follow it, and you return to the source. The indestructible kernel planted by the Holy Immortals connects all.
cards.grounded_supported: A thread connects things that seemed separate — this relationship, that decision from years ago, this current situation — and following it clarifies things.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating each life event as isolated, missing the pattern that would actually help you understand the current one.
cards.grounded_where: A current situation that echoes an old one you haven't connected the dots on yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can see the thread connecting this situation to an older one you haven't yet related it to.

cards.title: The Radiant Sphere
cards.phrase: Within the radiant sphere, the flower awakens
cards.meditation: Envision a radiant globe of light, with a golden flower blooming inside. Breathe with it, opening petal by petal into infinite brilliance
cards.interpretation: The heart of creation blossoms eternally; you are both the flower and the radiance that sustains it. All creation is gathered back into the One.
cards.grounded_supported: Something you've been tending quietly (a relationship, a skill, a habit) is actually flowering now — the tending worked.
cards.grounded_resisted: Missing or dismissing quiet growth because it wasn't dramatic or fast.
cards.grounded_where: Slow progress you haven't given yourself credit for because it wasn't sudden.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll credit slow, quiet growth as real progress instead of dismissing it for not being dramatic.

cards.title: The Hidden Expanse
cards.phrase: The web of stars reveals the hidden order
cards.meditation: Envision a radiant grid of golden lines stretching across the universe. Feel yourself both inside and beyond it, woven into the geometry of creation
cards.interpretation: Behind all appearances is a divine order. Trust the patterns that hold you; they are the language of the cosmos. Endless light unfolds beyond perception.
cards.grounded_supported: A pattern you couldn't see up close becomes obvious with a little distance — the order was there, you just needed the wider view.
cards.grounded_resisted: Judging a situation entirely from inside it, missing the larger pattern a step back would reveal.
cards.grounded_where: A confusing situation you haven't yet stepped back far enough from to see clearly.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether stepping back would reveal a pattern you can't see while you're still standing inside it.

cards.title: The Heart of Light
cards.phrase: From the depths of being, love ascends as flame
cards.meditation: Visualize a golden heart glowing at the center of the Earth. With each breath, let its warmth rise through you, filling your chest with radiant love
cards.interpretation: The truest light emerges from love; it is the fountain from which all life is blessed. Holy devotion is the radiant heart where love, humility, and sacred light converge.
cards.grounded_supported: Genuine care for someone (or something) turns out to be the actual source of your strength, not a distraction from it.
cards.grounded_resisted: Treating love or care as soft or secondary, sidelining it in favor of what looks more like 'real' priorities.
cards.grounded_where: A relationship or cause you love that you've deprioritized in favor of more 'serious' obligations.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll treat genuine care as central, not something secondary to what looks more serious.

cards.title: The Divine Descent
cards.phrase: Heaven's light seeks the prepared vessel
cards.meditation: Stand open as radiant beams of wisdom pour through you, transforming darkness into luminous understanding
cards.interpretation: When you align with higher purpose, divine light naturally flows through you to illuminate the world. Divine order manifests in flame through embodiment.
cards.grounded_supported: You're ready to be the one who carries something for others — the capacity you built earlier is now needed by someone else.
cards.grounded_resisted: Avoiding a leadership or support role you're actually ready for, out of old self-doubt.
cards.grounded_where: A responsibility or role you've been offered (or could step into) that you're underselling your readiness for.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll actually step into a role or responsibility you're ready for, instead of underselling your readiness.

cards.title: The Spiral Ascent
cards.phrase: The golden stair rises through worlds of light
cards.meditation: See yourself walking a spiral staircase of luminous gold. Each step lifts you toward spheres of greater brilliance, with no end in sight
cards.interpretation: The path is endless, each step a new revelation. The journey itself is the initiation. The soul's passage beyond death leads through the luminous threshold.
cards.grounded_supported: You stop needing an endpoint to feel like the effort is worth it — each stage of a long process has its own value.
cards.grounded_resisted: Devaluing the current stage of a long journey because it isn't the final one.
cards.grounded_where: A multi-stage goal where you're discounting real progress because you're not 'there' yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can value the current stage of a long process instead of discounting it for not being the last one.

cards.title: The Veils of Passage
cards.phrase: Between veils, the path of choice appears
cards.meditation: Stand before two radiant gateways, one golden and one shadowed. Allow your soul to know which path is yours without forcing the mind to choose
cards.interpretation: Choice is sacred. Every doorway leads further, but the one aligned with your essence opens into truth. The duality presents path of light or path of darkness.
cards.grounded_supported: You make a real choice — not the default, not the easiest, the one that's actually aligned — even though another option was right there.
cards.grounded_resisted: Letting inertia or convenience choose for you instead of making an active, considered decision.
cards.grounded_where: A decision you've been letting happen by default instead of actually choosing.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll make an active, considered choice instead of letting the default option choose for you.

cards.title: The Flower of Forms
cards.phrase: The living geometry blossoms from unity
cards.meditation: Imagine a radiant flower blooming upward, surrounded by crystalline polyhedra. Each form is a living principle born of the one light
cards.interpretation: Creation unfolds as form and beauty, each petal and shape an echo of the same source. The higher soul achieves eternal liberation.
cards.grounded_supported: Something you've been working toward finally takes a shape you can see and share, not just something you privately believe in.
cards.grounded_resisted: Keeping potential permanently theoretical, never letting it take a concrete, visible form.
cards.grounded_where: A long-held idea or goal that's still entirely private and unformed.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let a long-held idea take a real, visible form instead of keeping it permanently private.

cards.title: The Triune Light
cards.phrase: The One radiates as triangle and cube
cards.meditation: Focus on the golden triangle of light before you. In its center, see the cube of pure being. Hold yourself within its balance of spirit, mind, and matter
cards.interpretation: All forms are but reflections of the eternal triad. Within it, unity holds diversity. The triple essence of creation manifests through divine wisdom, holy spirit, and cosmic order.
cards.grounded_supported: Three things you've been juggling — logic, feeling, and action — finally move together instead of pulling against each other.
cards.grounded_resisted: Letting one dimension (usually the loudest — logic, or emotion, or urgency) override the other two.
cards.grounded_where: A decision where your head, your gut, and your calendar are giving you three different answers.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let logic, feeling, and practical reality all inform a decision instead of just the loudest one.

cards.title: The Twin Suns
cards.phrase: The greater light awakens the lesser flame
cards.meditation: Visualize a great sun shining above, radiating waves into a smaller sun below. Feel yourself as the bridge where the higher ignites the lower
cards.interpretation: The greater always seeks to awaken the lesser. As above shines upon below, your inner flame is kindled. The cosmic crossing leads beyond the sea of stars.
cards.grounded_supported: Someone further along than you (a mentor, an example) helps activate something in you just by their presence, not by teaching you directly.
cards.grounded_resisted: Waiting passively for inspiration or guidance instead of putting yourself near the people or situations that would spark it.
cards.grounded_where: A mentor, community, or influence you haven't sought out yet that could genuinely move you.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll actively seek out a mentor or influence that could move you, instead of waiting passively for inspiration.

cards.title: The Black Sun Of Revelation
cards.phrase: In the eclipse, hidden fire is unveiled
cards.meditation: Envision the black sun blazing with radiant beams behind it. Rest in the still point where shadow guards the secret light
cards.interpretation: The black sun is the womb of revelation—its darkness births the most radiant truth. The deceptive shadow cast by the Destructive Spirit conceals deeper illumination.
cards.grounded_supported: Something uncomfortable coming to light turns out to be the thing that actually resolves a longer-running problem.
cards.grounded_resisted: Avoiding an uncomfortable truth because the temporary relief of not-knowing feels safer than the clarity would.
cards.grounded_where: A hard truth you sense but haven't let yourself fully look at yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll look directly at an uncomfortable truth instead of staying in the relief of not-knowing.

cards.title: Pyramid of the Radiant Flower
cards.phrase: From foundation to crown, geometry blossoms
cards.meditation: See a pyramid rising toward a sphere of light that blooms like a flower above it. Let its rays crown your being
cards.interpretation: The pyramid anchors, the flower crowns; in their union, the soul finds perfect harmony. The unending solar source is the symbol of supreme divinity.
cards.grounded_supported: A solid foundation (routine, boundary, financial base) makes the more exciting, expressive parts of your life possible — not the other way around.
cards.grounded_resisted: Chasing the exciting parts of a goal while skipping the unglamorous foundation that would actually make them sustainable.
cards.grounded_where: An ambitious goal missing the boring groundwork it actually depends on.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll build the unglamorous foundation a goal actually needs, not just chase its exciting parts.

cards.title: Sacred Fire Rising
cards.phrase: What breaks becomes the seed of design
cards.meditation: Visualize shards of starlight dissolving into streams that form a lattice of sacred geometry. From chaos, a new order emerges
cards.interpretation: Fragments are never wasted; even the broken finds its place in the eternal pattern. The eternal flame rises as the core of sacred temples.
cards.grounded_supported: Something that broke or fell apart turns out to be usable material for what comes next, not just a loss.
cards.grounded_resisted: Writing off a setback entirely as waste, without looking for what's still usable in it.
cards.grounded_where: A failed plan, ended relationship, or lost opportunity you haven't looked back at for what it left you with.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can find what's still usable in a setback instead of writing the whole thing off as waste.

cards.title: Pillar of Fire at Dawn
cards.phrase: The horizon burns into ascent
cards.meditation: Envision the fiery column erupting from the earth into the sky. Let its heat rise within your spine, carrying you upward
cards.interpretation: Dawn is not gentle but fierce—the fire that rises is the same flame within you. Dawn shines as the revelation of truth and cosmic order.
cards.grounded_supported: A necessary confrontation or start is intense, not gentle — and that intensity is appropriate, not a sign something's wrong.
cards.grounded_resisted: Expecting a hard beginning to feel easy, and treating the difficulty as a reason to delay.
cards.grounded_where: A hard but necessary start (a conversation, a change) you're avoiding because it doesn't feel gentle enough.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you can let a necessary beginning be intense, instead of expecting it to feel easy first.

cards.title: The Citadel
cards.phrase: The spire of eternity pierces the heavens
cards.meditation: See a vast cathedral of light ascending into infinity, its spires aligned with the stars. Enter and feel yourself become its structure
cards.interpretation: The soul is both pilgrim and temple; its cathedral is built of radiant ascent. Good Mind creates a stronghold of pure thought protecting the soul.
cards.grounded_supported: Clear thinking becomes an actual defense — a settled mind protects you better than reacting or over-explaining would.
cards.grounded_resisted: Getting pulled into defending yourself reactively instead of staying settled and letting clarity do the work.
cards.grounded_where: A situation where you're tempted to over-explain or argue instead of staying calmly clear.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether a settled, clear mind can be your actual defense, instead of over-explaining or reacting.

cards.title: Salvation
cards.phrase: The celestial bow bends across the night
cards.meditation: Envision the rainbow arc stretching over a golden horizon, linking earth and cosmos. Breathe in its spectrum of living fire
cards.interpretation: The rainbow is a covenant between worlds, a reminder that light always bends back to embrace life. The future savior ushers in final renewal where death and evil are overcome.
cards.grounded_supported: After a hard stretch, something genuinely eases — not everything is fixed, but the worst part has passed.
cards.grounded_resisted: Staying braced for more difficulty even after the situation has actually started to soften.
cards.grounded_where: A hard period that's actually improving, but you haven't let yourself register the relief yet.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll let yourself register real relief, instead of staying braced for difficulty that has already passed.

cards.title: The Temple
cards.phrase: Circles within circles weave the eternal hymn
cards.meditation: Visualize infinite interlocking circles of light spiraling outward. Hear their resonance as a silent mandala-song of the cosmos
cards.interpretation: Creation is a mandala in motion; by entering it, you become one with its endless symphony. The sacred fire temple is the gateway between human devotion and divine presence.
cards.grounded_supported: You feel part of something whole — a project, a community, a life — completing, rather than fragmenting further.
cards.grounded_resisted: Staying in analysis or preparation mode past the point where you could actually step into what you've built.
cards.grounded_where: Something you've been building that's actually ready for you to fully step into, not just keep refining.
cards.grounded_where_v2: This is testing whether you'll actually step into what you've built, instead of staying in preparation past the point it's needed.
